newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares up 4.53 pct, close at year high.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares up 4.53 pct, close at year high.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index rebounded strongly on Thursday despite profit-taking, closing at its highest level since November 1993 following Wednesday's modest correction, brokers said.
The B index rose 7.47 points, or 4.53 percent, to close at 172.25. It touched an intra-session high of 172.44 and low of 165.28 as turnover rose to HK$505.51 million from Wednesday's 427.69 million.
Brokers said investors believed the market had effected a basic turnaround as a result of its bull run in recent weeks and are now injecting more money into B shares.
"Sentiment was fairly bullish on Thursday despite some profit-taking. Investors bought on dips due to optimism over the market," said a broker at China Southern Securities.
"An increasing number of domestic and overseas investors have been queuing in front of the Shenzhen Securities Registration Co to open B share trading accounts," he said.
The market still has strength to rise further, barring negative news, one analyst said.
Changan Automobile, the day's star, surged HK$0.54, or 10.69 percent, to HK$5.59 on the session's third heaviest trade of 7.33 million shares due to institutional support , brokers said.

Dadonghai followed, rising HK$0.47, or 10.63 percent, to HK$4.89 on volume of 3.93 million shares. Lizhu Pharmaceutical climbed HK$0.52, or 10.24 percent, to HK$5.60 on trade volume of 5.38 million shares.

Appliance maker Tsann Kuen advanced HK$0.47, or 9.89 percent, to HK$5.22, with 6.11 million shares traded. One broker said the counter had performed more weakly than most of the other Shenzhen-listed B issues.
Motorbike producer North Jianshe traded the most on volume of 8.11 million shares and was up HK$0.30 at HK$4.99.
The A share market rose in active speculative trading, with the A index gaining 8.47 points, or 1.81 percent, to end at its record closing high of 477.35.
Turnover was 14.18 billion yuan, compared with 16.58 billion yuan the previous session.
The composite index finished up 8.59 points, or 1.94 percent, at 452.22.
Conglomerate Kunming Wuhua Industry (Group) Co Ltd, which listed 22.71 million A shares in Shenzhen on Thursday, ended at 22.18 yuan.
Previously, the shares were traded on the unofficial grey market at between eight and nine yuan and broking industry sources had expected them to be quoted at a minimum of 15 yuan on listing debut.
Hainan Jinhai Co Ltd, which listed 21.50 million A shares and 7.80 million staff shares in Shenzhen today, closed the session at 21.40 yuan.
The A shares were issued at 4.85 yuan each earlier this month, while the staff shares were offered at one yuan per share in 1993.
